principles: Extend existing owners and sources of truth
Keep the first milestone bounded and dependency-free
Use targeted invalidation and explicit acknowledgment boundaries
Treat cancellation, stale work and shutdown as intentional paths
Do not conflate generated, synthesized, locally drained and remotely played output
signal_strategy: Keep existing VAD and transcript evidence and current hard-stop behavior; add no classifier or timing threshold
out_of_scope: All files outside the explicit milestone 1 list
Provider and channel changes pending milestone 2 amendment
VAD, EOS, UI and provider configuration changes
Public protocol, SDK, schema, migration and deployment changes
Remote cancellation and rollback of tool side effects
Reversible pause, semantic classification and played-text reconstruction

actions: Resolve RFC open questions and approve exact implementation scope
Obtain independent plan challenge and coordinator attestation
Challenge final Accepted RFC bytes and obtain exact-digest confirmation

steps.write_scope: Only the two listed lifecycle files
actions: Add conditional expected-context transition under the existing mutex
Return old/new context, prior state and actual assistant-interruption disposition
Cover idle entry, active user turns, stale targets and concurrent duplicate signals

steps.write_scope: Only the four listed model files
actions: Pass interruption ContextID to targeted invalidation
Serialize active request changes, history mutation and tool admission decisions
Use executor-before-history lock order without I/O or callbacks under locks
Reject old completions and follow-ups after invalidation before another user turn
Preserve valid tool history and distinguish admitted side effects from rejected work

steps.write_scope: Only the five listed adapter files
actions: Use the conditional lifecycle result for barge-in decisions
Consolidate duplicate interruption orchestration in the existing handler
Queue targeted model invalidation before new-turn provider activation
Preserve trigger, transcript, trailing VAD-end, greeting and EOS compatibility
Record local commitment and invalidation boundaries without claiming remote stop
Run deterministic regression tests, race tests and executor compatibility suites
Run explicit finalization and two-turn audio smoke test
Require no unresolved critical or major findings before rollout

parallelism: After design confirmation only, lifecycle and model work may run independently with disjoint write scopes; adapter integration stays with coordinator
acceptance_criteria: One expected context commits at most one interruption transition
Old or empty interruption targets cannot cancel a newer response
Matching model invalidation rejects late output before the next user turn
Rejected completion cannot append model history or admit tool work
Existing modes, greeting policy, EOS input delivery and other executor tests pass
All changed packages have success and failure/concurrency coverage
Required tests, finalization, independent review and gates pass
required_tests: Concurrent VAD/STT and duplicate target lifecycle transitions
Active user turn and assistant idle entry without spurious interruption events
Word/VAD options, trailing VAD-end, transcript and greeting compatibility
Late completion after matching invalidation with no new user turn
Old interruption racing new request activation
Completion admitted before invalidation versus rejected afterward
Pending tool result/follow-up and valid call/result history pairs
verification_note: The finalization command lists proposed scope. At implementation completion supply only actual changed paths. Commands above are planned, not evidence of execution.
risks: Lifecycle commitment and executor invalidation remain separate completion boundaries
Existing queues can delay interrupt consumption
Incorrect lock ordering could deadlock model history processing
Provider callbacks and output clear remain independently scheduled until milestone 2
Already admitted tools can complete side effects after interruption
Other lifecycle interface consumers may require a scope amendment
Existing generated-text persistence does not represent played text
rollback: Revert the complete milestone 1 patch and deploy the previous assistant service build; no schema or configuration migration. Do not undo unrelated changes. Admitted tool side effects are not reversible.
